title: VibeGuard diagnostics output (v1)
description: Machine-readable diagnostics array emitted by `vibeguard scan --diagnostics` (and `gate --diagnostics`). Each record is shaped to be consumable as a VS Code / LSP `Diagnostic`. Stable contract for editor extensions and AI coding agents. Schema identifier: `vibeguard/diagnostics/v1`.

severity.description: VS Code `DiagnosticSeverity`. 0=Error, 1=Warning, 2=Information, 3=Hint. VibeGuard mapping: critical/high → 0, medium → 1, low → 2, info → 3.

code.description: Stable finding identifier (e.g. `SEC-AWSACCESSKEY`). Mirrors `Finding.id` and is used as the LSP `Diagnostic.code`.

source.description: Always the string `vibeguard`. Lets multi-source diagnostics consumers attribute the finding.

message.description: Short human-readable title (the `Finding.title`). For the long-form description and recommendation, see `data.description` and `data.recommendation`.

file.description: Relative file path with forward slashes (Windows paths are normalised here).

tags.description: LSP `DiagnosticTag` integers (1=Unnecessary, 2=Deprecated). VibeGuard's rule families don't currently map onto this enum, so the field is emitted as `[]`. VibeGuard category tags live under `data.tags`.

Range.description: LSP range. VibeGuard emits a zero-width range at the finding's line (start == end) because findings are line-scoped, not column-scoped.

line.description: 0-based line number (LSP convention). VibeGuard's 1-based `Finding.line` is decremented by 1 here. Findings without a line number (or with line<=0) collapse to 0.

character.description: 0-based character offset within the line. Always 0 in v1 — VibeGuard findings are line-scoped.

schema.description: Per-record schema identifier. Bumped only on a breaking change to the shape. Consumers should refuse unknown versions rather than degrade silently.

fingerprint.description: Deterministic finding identity — same SHA-256 hex emitted in JSON output, SARIF `partialFingerprints`, and the baseline file. Algorithm: `sha256(id + ':' + normalized_path + ':' + sha256(stored_evidence)[:16])`. See `docs/output-schemas.md` §1.

rule.description: Singular rule family that produced the finding (e.g. `secrets`, `risky_diff`, `sourcemaps`). Issue #51 called this field `rule_id`; renamed to `rule` for consistency with `Finding.rule`.

tags.description: Per-finding category tag list. Can include the same string as `rule` plus cross-cutting tags like `supply-chain`. Note: this is *not* the LSP `DiagnosticTag[]` — that field lives at the record's top level.

confidence.description: Rule's confidence in the match. Mirrors `Finding.confidence`.

severity_label.description: VibeGuard's native severity string. The numeric top-level `severity` is the LSP/VS Code mapping; this preserves the original 5-level scale. Issue #51 called this field `vibeguard_severity`; renamed to `severity_label`.

evidence.description: Optional snippet of the offending content, truncated to 200 characters + a `…` marker if the original was longer. Omitted entirely when the rule didn't capture evidence.
